title: Beacon Ridge C&I Structure Schedule: Energy Pricing and Cost Components
content:
Commercial and Industrial Electricity Contracts are offered in six structures. Each structure fixes how energy is priced and whether capacity, network transmission, ancillary services and line losses are billed separately at cost (pass-through) or included in the energy price.

## Schedule of structures

| Structure | Contract structure | Energy priced as | Capacity cost | Transmission cost | Ancillary services and line losses | Source of the fixed block size |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Beacon Ridge C&I Real-Time Index | real-time index | index plus adder | pass-through | pass-through | included | not applicable |
| Beacon Ridge C&I Block and Index | block and index | fixed block plus index balance | pass-through | pass-through | included | quoted block kWh per cycle |
| Beacon Ridge C&I Fixed Energy with Capacity and Transmission Pass-Through | fixed energy, capacity and transmission pass-through | fixed | pass-through | pass-through | included | not applicable |
| Beacon Ridge C&I Fixed Energy with Capacity Pass-Through | fixed energy, capacity pass-through | fixed | pass-through | included | included | not applicable |
| Beacon Ridge C&I Fixed All-In | fixed all-in | fixed | included | included | included | not applicable |
| Beacon Ridge C&I Fixed All-In Renewable | fixed all-in | fixed | included | included | included | not applicable |

"Pass-through" means the cost is billed separately at cost; "included" means it is carried inside the energy price. Ancillary services and line losses are included on every structure.

## Market index

| Item | Every structure |
|---|---|
| Market index used for index-priced energy | PJM real-time LMP, utility load zone, monthly load-weighted average |
| Notice that prices a billing cycle's index energy | the notice for the month in which the billing period starts |

## Reading the schedule

- **Which structures price any energy on the index?** Real-Time Index (all energy at the index plus the quoted adder) and Block and Index (a fixed block, with the balance on the index). The four remaining structures price energy at a fixed price.
- **Which structures carry neither capacity nor transmission at cost?** Fixed All-In and Fixed All-In Renewable, where both are included.
- **Where does a block size come from?** Only a Block and Index contract has one, and it is the block kWh per cycle stated in the signed quote; for the other five structures the item does not apply.
- **Example (hypothetical):** a billing cycle running from 18 April to 17 May takes its index price from the April notice, because April is the month in which that billing period starts.
